title: Performance: memo, the profiler, and the re-render nobody asked for

videos.script:
Lesson three said React calls a component again whenever its parent renders, and left a question for later: is that a problem? Today you measure, before changing anything.

{{measure}} First the Profiler, which prints a line each time part of the screen is drawn. Opening a dialog redraws every row of the list, although nothing about them changed.

{{memo}} Then memo, which skips a component whose props are the same. One row redrawn instead of all of them, and the reason it works: React Query keeps the objects that did not change.

{{fails}} Then how memo does nothing at all: one inline arrow function, new on every render.

{{compiler}} And last, the React Compiler, switched on at last. No memo in the code, the same result in the browser, and the inline arrow harmless.
